title: The Hanging Wood
text: Every branch for a mile holds a little bundle of cloth and string, hundreds upon hundreds of them, swaying and turning. Some are knotted round small bones, some round teeth. Some are still damp. Some of them twitch.

options.label: The Leader cuts one down and opens it, needing to know what they hold.

outcomes.text: Inside is a charm, old but strong, wrapped around a tooth.
Inside is a name, freshly written. It is the Leader's.

options.label: Tie up a bundle of your own, for luck, as others have before.

outcomes.text: The wood seems to settle around you, as if you had answered a question correctly.

options.label: Burn a path through the bundles. Whatever they are for, it is not good.

outcomes.text: The wood burns screaming. What comes out of the smoke is not happy about it.
